deploybot: [migration-slot] Claim attempt: 04/22 02:00-03:00 UTC for migration m-6219 (functional index + compact rewrite). Canaries=2. Ack in 10m or slot freed.
Rachel: Overview: we're adding a deterministic functional index on users(email_norm) and performing a compact backfill using background workers. Cutover will use a fast rename which holds a brief lock (~300-600ms).
Tom: Request: pin canaries to tag release-3.4.0-dbalpha to avoid any code that assumes the new index. If canary errors revert to release-3.3.8. Also gate reads behind ff:email_index_ready.
SRE-oncall: I'll wire temporal autotuning. If replica_lag > 22s for 2m then reduce worker throttle by 60%. If lag >40s for 90s pause workers and page #eng-sre.
Jules: I'll own the cutover window (01:50-03:20 UTC). Smoke condition: GET /v1/profile?email=test@example.com must be <200ms and return 200. If not, abort.
Rachel: Adding safety: after swap we immediately rename old index to users_email_idx_prev and keep for 12m before async drop. That lets us revert name pointers quickly without rebuild.
Tom: Runbook excerpt (sanitized):
```
-- preflight
SELECT now();
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event IS NOT NULL;
SELECT replay_lag, sync_state FROM pg_stat_replication LIMIT 3;
-- progress
SELECT migration_id, phase, done_chunks, total_chunks FROM migration_tracker WHERE migration_id='m-6219';
```
SRE-oncall: Rollback matrix: 1) Pre-swap abort: stop workers, no swap -> zero user impact. 2) Post-swap revert: quick rename swap back under brief lock (~300ms) to users_email_idx_prev -> users_email_idx; small blip expected. 3) If old index dropped, full rebuild required (expensive). Documented commands will be in ops-runbook.
ops-bot: Holdpoint created: manual-unpin required to proceed to global rollout. Auto-abort if preflight fails. Release notes will reference m-6219.
Tom: Also mute index-build metrics for 50m to prevent noisy alerts. Annotate dashboards with migration id.
Jules: Will post canary smoke timestamps & metrics during action. If auth p99 > 250ms or profile query >200ms during canary, we abort.
Rachel: SQL (redacted):
```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY users_email_norm_shadow ON users ((lower(email_norm))) WITH (fillfactor=85);
-- background chunked workers fill the shadow index
-- swap: BEGIN; LOCK TABLE users IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; ALTER INDEX users_email_norm_shadow RENAME TO users_email_idx; COMMIT;
```
Tom: Good. One more: implement a quick-query fallback that forces planner to prefer old index for 10m if we detect regressions (config flag).
SRE-oncall: I'll add a temporary planner hint toggle in the app infra to route queries away from new index if needed.
Jules: Claiming slot now. deploybot0:00 UTC canaries scheduled. Post canary health and final go/no-go here.
deploybot: Slot claimed. Will update thread with canary health, and final decision.
